By: Jo Munnik | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Around the world older women dating younger men is becoming increasingly common. And it is happening right here in SA too. We dive into the world of so-called 'cougars'.

Summary:
In the twenty tweens women who are in relationships or engage in casual sex with younger men are referred to as 'cougars'. This is a trend that has been set by Hollywood's leading ladies and has taken off globally.

We look at the trend from a local point of view as we explore relationship dynamics between older women and younger men.. From a casual and long term point of view.

We also explore how this trend has become associated with empowering older women and the freedom of choice.

The story includes:

a cougar, a couple, a sociologist, a sexologist and we conduct a social experiment as we go online and ask men what they find attractive about older women.

Press Release:


Cougar’s den
Hollywood stars like Demi Moore and Susan Sarandon have thrust the phenomenon of older women dating much younger men under the limelight. Seen as using mature and feminine wiles to prey on youthful males, these women are often dubbed Cougars. But the gorgeous older women we speak to, who actively pursue these relationships, tell us it’s all about passion between two people in their sexual prime and meaningful companionship. Carte Blanche enters the Cougar’s den.
Producer: Jo Munnik
Presenter: Devi Sankaree Govender and John Webb

Script:


26 YEARS OLD – MALE VO – GRAPHIC
I THINK AN OLDER WOMAN THAT LOOKS AFTER HERSELF IS A HELL OF A LOT MORE STUNNING THAN A GIRL MY AGE. AND I'VE ALWAYS WANTED TO SEE IF AN OLDER WOMAN CAN REALLY TEACH ME.

28 YEARS OLD – MALE VO – GRAPHIC
OLDER WOMEN MAKE FOR A BETTER, MORE FULFILLING SEXUAL EXPERIENCE.

ERLA:
YOU GET OUT THERE AND THESE YOUNGER GUYS ARE ACTUALLY HUNTING YOU. IT’S NOT THE OTHER WAY AROUND.

ERLA:
I WENT ON TINDER, I WAS HARASSED. PROMISE YOU, FLOODED, BY YOUNGER MEN.

DEVI:
SO THEY WANT OLDER WOMEN?

ERLA:
OH YES. (LAUGHING).

VO:
ERLA DIEDERICKS IS AN AUTHOR AND JOURNALIST WHO HAS DIPPED HER TOE INTO THE POOL OF YOUNGER MEN.
AND SHE IS ONE OF THOUSANDS.

ERLA:
YOUNG MEN WANT US. AND WE ARE SIMPLY SAYING YES.

VO:
CLINICAL PSYCHOLOGIST DR DEE UNPACKS THE ATTRACTION.

DR DEE
WHAT YOUNGER MEN FIND IN OLDER WOMEN IS THEY HAVE THEIR OWN LIFE, SO THEY DON’T FEEL A SENSE OF RESPONSIBILITY. OLDER WOMEN CAN HOLD THEIR OWN. OLDER WOMEN ENJOY THE FACT THAT THEY ARE ACCEPTED FOR THEIR CAREERS, THEIR STATUS.

SOME HAVE EVEN MENTIONED TO ME THAT THEY ENJOY THE FACT THAT THEY ARE NOT AS DEPENDENT ON SOCIAL MEDIA AND THERE IS MORE OF A SENSE OF MYSTERY AND PRIVACY.

JOHN
PRIOR TO MEETING EACH OTHER, HAD YOU BEEN INTERESTED IN OLDER WOMEN?

MICHAEL
I HAD A FEW RELATIONSHIPS WITH WOMEN WHO WERE OLDER. JUST BECAUSE I THINK I WAS A BIT MORE MATURE THAN MY AGE GROUP AT THE TIME AND WAS ATTRACTED TO WOMEN WHO WERE MUCH OLDER.

VO
MICHAEL & HELENA WITKIN HAVE BEEN TOGETHER FOR 13 YEARS. SHE IS ELEVEN YEARS HIS SENIOR.

HELENA:
AT THE TIME MIKEY WAS 19 AND I WAS 30.

JOHN:
MICHAEL, WAS IT EVER A SUBSTANTIAL ISSUE FOR YOU? THE AGE DIFFERENCE?

MICHAEL:
NOT AT ALL. IT IS A LARGE GAP, BUT IT WORKS FOR US.

HELENA:
THE WORST PART IS BEING REFERRED TO AS THE OLDER.
THE OTHER DAY SOMEONE THOUGHT I WAS MIKEY’S MOM.

VO:
IN THE TWENTY TEENS YOUNGER MEN WHO DATE OR HAVE SEX WITH OLDER WOMEN ARE SO-CALLED ‘CUBS’ AND THE OLDER WOMEN ARE REFERRED TO AS ‘COUGARS’.

PROF REDDY:
WELL, ‘COUGAR’ IS ACTUALLY A VERY INTERESTING CONCEPT. THE COUGAR AS WE KNOW WOMEN ARE OFTEN ASSOCIATED WITH WILD CAT BEHAVIOUR.

VO:
HUMAN SCIENCES RESEARCH COUNCIL PROFESSOR OF HUMAN AND SOCIAL DEVELOPMENT, VASU REDDY, EXPLAINS WHAT THIS LABEL MEANS.

PROF REDDY:
OVER THE YEARS IT HAS BASICALLY COME TO MEAN A RELATIONSHIP THAT AN OLDER WOMAN HAS WITH A YOUNGER MAN. THE AGE GAP IS USUALLY AT STAKE HERE. THE WOMAN IS USUALLY IN HER FORTIES AND THE MAN IS MUCH YOUNGER.

DEVI:
IN TERMS OF WHO YOU’VE DATED, WHAT WAS THE AGE DIFFERENCE LIKE?

ERLA:
20 YEARS. COULD BE MY SON.

DEVI:
WHAT WAS THAT LIKE?

ERLA:
WELL, WE WERE ABOUT TO MEET. AND HE ARRIVED ON HIS BIKE. AND I REMEMBER THINKING, HE LOOKS SO YOUNG. AND HE SAT DOWN AND HE LOOKED AT ME, AND I AM SURE HE THOUGHT I LOOKED ABSOLUTELY AMAZING AND SEXY AND THEN HE BENT OUT AND PULLED OUT A LITTLE HAIR ON MY CHIN. I SWEAR. I THOUGHT, MAYBE THIS IS NOT FOR ME.

DEVI:
THAT LASTED HOW LONG?

ERLA:
IT WAS VERY SHORT LIVED. THOSE THINGS NORMALLY ARE. YOU CAN ONLY GO A FEW ROUND WITH THESE GUYS AND THEN YOU GET BORED.
IT’S LIKE A JOY RIDE.

LINK:
SEX IS IMPORTANT FOR OTHER IT MEANS MORE

MICHAEL
AT THE TIME, HELENA WAS IN NEED OF SOME WISDOM THAT I HAD – THE WISDOM OF YOUTH AND I WAS IN NEED OF SOME WISDOM OF SOMEONE IN THEIR THIRTIES AND AS WE HAVE GROWN TOGETHER AND AGED TOGETHER, WE HAVE DIFFERENT LESSONS TO SHARE WITH EACH OTHER FROM THESE DIFFERENT GENERATIONAL SIDES.

VO:
ACCORDING TO SEXOLOGIST DR EVE, THIS DYNAMIC REPRESENTS A SIGNIFICANT SHIFT IN HOW WOMEN VIEW RELATIONSHIPS.

DR EVE:
OLDER WOMEN ARE SAYING, WELL ACTUALLY I’VE BEEN IN A SIGNIFICANT RELATIONSHIP WHEN I WAS YOUNGER .. AND NOW I AM AT AS STAGE IN MY LIFE WHERE I AM LOOKING FOR A DIFFERENT TYPE OF RELATIONSHIP. I WANT TO HAVE FUN IN THE MOMENT RIGHT NOW AND THAT’S WHAT I AM GOING TO GET FROM A YOUNGER GUY.

VO:
AND, OF COURSE, A SIGNIFICANT FACTOR IN WHAT ATTRACTS OLDER WOMEN AND YOUNGER MEN – IS SEX.

DEVI – TO ERLA:
WHAT DO OLDER WOMEN SAY ABOUT THE SEX?

ERLA:
THEY SAY THE SEX IS HOT. BECAUSE THESE GUYS GO ON FOR HOURS. THEY’VE GOT THE ENDURANCE …. THEY ARE GORGEOUS.

DEVI:
AND WHAT TO DO THE MEN SAY ABOUT THE SEX?

ERLA:
THEY SAY IT’S AWESOME. (LAUGHS)

DR EVE:
IT’S A PERFECT FIT. IT’S LIKE TAKING TWO COGS AND IT’S MAGNIFICENT. ….
LEARNT HER BODY .. AND HE IS IN HIS SEXUAL PRIME… GO FOR ANOTHER ROUND AND SHE’S UP FOR IT.

VO:
SOCIAL MEDIA AND THE INTERNET HAVE OPENED UP A WHOLE NEW WORLD OF DATING OPTIONS - FROM TINDER TO ONLINE SITES LIKE DATE A GRANNY.

DEVI
STATS SHOW THAT ONLINE WOMEN ARE INCREASINGLY LOOKING FOR YOUNGER MEN.

DR EVE
IF I LOOK AT WHO IS VISITING A SITE LIKE COUGAR LIFE, WHICH IS A VERY POPULAR, THE MAJORITY OF MALE MEMBERS ARE 18- 29 YEARS OLD. AND THE MAJORITY OF FEMALE MEMBERS ARE 40 – 49 YEARS OLD. WHAT THEY ALL SAY THAT THEY ARE THERE FOR, IS SEX. WHICH IS CALLED NSA, NO STRINGS ATTACHED SEX.
A
VO
WE DECIDED TO TEST THE WATERS AND SET UP AN ONLINE PROFILE FOR A 49 YEAR OLD COUGAR.
IN JUST A FEW DAYS OUR CARTE BLANCHE COUGAR WAS PURSUED BY OVER ONE HUNDRED MEN RANGING IN AGE FROM 18 UPWARDS. WE ASKED THEM WHAT THEY FIND ATTRACTIVE ABOUT OLDER WOMEN.

30 YEARS OLD – MALE VO – GRAPHIC
“WHAT I LOVE ABOUT OLDER WOMEN, WHERE TO BEGIN? THERE’S NO COMPLICATIONS. THINGS ARE SIMPLE AND NO TIME FOR GAMES. AN OLDER WOMAN KNOWS WHAT SHE WANTS AND LIKES AND WHEN SHE WANTS IT… “
.
27 YEARS OLD – MALE VO – GRAPHIC
“I WANT TO BE WITH OLDER WOMEN BECAUSE THEY KNOW WHAT THEY WANT AND THEY ARE MORE GROWN UP”

JOHN
WHAT ABOUT THE OLDER MEN? WHERE DOES THIS LEAVE THEM?

DR EVE
THOSE MEN ARE TAKING VIAGRA AND LOOKING AFTER THEIR SEXUAL HEALTH. THEY ARE HIGH STOCK. AND ARE EVOLUTIONARY STILL ATTRACTIVE TO YOUNGER WOMEN. WHICH IS WHY WOMEN ARE CONSTANTLY REDEFINING THEIR BODIES.


VO:
AS WITH ALL RELATIONSHIPS, LIAISONS BETWEEN OLDER WOMEN AND YOUNGER MEN COME WITH THEIR OWN SET OF CHALLENGES.

JOHN
DID YOU EVER DEAL WITH ANY SORT OF PREJUDICE?

MICHAEL
OH, ABSOLUTELY.

HELENA
ONE HUNDRED PERCENT.

MICHAEL
FOR THE FIRST FEW YEARS IT WAS DIFFICULT.

HELENA
ONCE YOU HAVE CHILDREN, PEOPLE DON’T PICK ON YOU IN THE SAME WAY.

DEVI LINK
WHEN OLDER WOMEN DATE YOUNGER GUYS, EYEBROWS ARE RAISED. BUT WHY? WHEN WE ALREADY LIVE IN AN OPEN SOCIETY.

DR EVE
WHILST WOMEN ARE FEELING EMPOWERED AND GOOD ABOUT GETTING A YOUNGER MAN, THERE IS STILL THIS SOCIETAL STORY THAT IS GOING ON THAT IS LOOKING AT WOMEN AND GOING TSK TSK, NOT VERY NICE. THIS IS CRADLE SNATCHING.. THIS ISN’T WHAT WOMEN SHOULD BE DOING.




PROF REDDY
IT IS VERY MUCH WHAT WE CALL A HETERO NORMATIVE EXPECTATION. THE IDEA THAT WOMEN SHOULD BE BEARING CHILDREN, NURTURING, TAKING CARE OF THE HUSBAND. AND CERTAINLY, NOT BEING OLDER BUT YOUNGER IN RELATIONSHIPS.

VO
HOWEVER, ERLA SAYS TIMES ARE CHANGING.

DEVI:
ARE MORE AND MORE OLDER WOMEN MORE CONFIDENT ABOUT DATING YOUNGER MEN IN SOUTH AFRICA? BECAUSE THERE HAS ALWAYS BEEN A STIGMA ATTACHED DO IT.

ERLA
YES. WHAT HAS CHANGED WITH THE WOMEN IS IT IS VERY ACCEPTABLE. EVERYONE IS DOING IT. I MEAN, J-LO AND MADONNA. IT’S A GLAMOROUS THING. WOMEN DON’T SEE IT AS A STIGMA ANYMORE.

VO:
AND WHAT ABOUT THE SOCIAL CONNOTATIONS OF THE TERM ‘COUGAR’.

ERLA:
I DON’T LIKE THAT TERM. IT’S A MALE TERM. A COUGAR HUNTS SMALLER PREY. THAT ARE HELPLESS. THOSE MEN AREN’T HELPLESS. THEY KNOW EXACTLY WHAT THEY ARE DOING.

PROF REDDY
I THINK IN MANY WAYS THE TERM COUGAR IS MEANT TO HAVE NEGATIVE CONNOTATIONS .. IDEA OF A WOMAN BEING A WILD CAT …. IN A PREDATORY WAY IS QUITE VALUE RIDDEN. CAN ALSO HAVE THE OPPOSITE MEANING IN THE SENSE OF BEING AFFIRMATIVE.. WOMEN CAN SEDUCE A YOUNGER MAN.

VO:
DESPITE THE CONTROVERSIAL LABEL, IT HAS COME TO REPRESENT FREEDOM OF CHOICE FOR OLDER WOMEN.

DR EVE:
BACK IN THE DAY THERE WAS TWO KIND OF RELATIONSHIP FORMS. YOU WERE EITHER MARRIED OR YOU WERE SINGLE. AND TODAY THERE ARE SO MANY MORE RELATIONSHIP CHOICES.

ERLA:
I AM 47 YEARS OLD AND I CAN LITERALLY DATE FROM 28 RIGHT UP TO 80. I THINK THAT’S EMPOWERING, IT’S NEVER BEEN LIKE THAT BEFORE. IT’S A WOMAN’S WORLD.

metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): Around the world older women dating younger men is becoming increasingly common. And it is happening right here in SA too. We dive into the world of so-called 'cougars'.
metadata.Summary: In the twenty tweens women who are in relationships or engage in casual sex with younger men are referred to as 'cougars'. This is a trend that has been set by Hollywood's leading ladies and has taken off globally. We look at the trend from a local point of view as we explore relationship dynamics between older women and younger men.. From a casual and long term point of view. We also explore how this trend has become associated with empowering older women and the freedom of choice. The story includes: a cougar, a couple, a sociologist, a sexologist and we conduct a social experiment as we go online and ask men what they find attractive about older women.
